name: forms2apex
description: Migrador open source de Oracle Forms para Oracle APEX com IA, RAG e relatório de regras pendentes

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r parser/requirements.txt && npm install
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && $(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) -m unittest discover -s parser -p 'test_*.py'
